positions.title: Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
We are building the Virtual Scale-up Platform for bioprocess optimization.

Our goal is to provide the digital infrastructure for industrial biomanufacturing. By integrating scale-down experiments with robotic lab automation and computational modeling, we optimize how microbes grow and produce—boosting yield, cutting costs, and accelerating R&D. From biomass to precision fermentation, we’re making biology predictable, programmable, and production-ready. We are Differential.

positions.title: Director neural compiler & AI SDK
positions.description:
Founding member and team lead of the neural compiler and AI SDK team. I built this team from 0 to 12 and lead it until leaving the company.
This team is also a key connecting element within Recogni. We gain an intricate understanding of our customers' needs and derive actionable design goals from them. At the core, our responsibility is to convert vanilla, float precision, unconstrained neural networks to work on Recogni's highly efficient and powerful chip. The task performance is maintained despite strong model compression and the use of low precision number formats.

company.tagline: Virtual Scale-up Platform for Bioprocess Optimization
company.description: Differential Bio is integrating scale-down experiments with AI-based modeling to optimize how industry-relevant microbes grow ("biomass fermentation") and produce ("precision fermentation"). By optimizing bioprocesses and growth conditions, the company is not only increasing their clients' R&D efficiency but alsodramatically improving bioproduction outcomes such as yield, cost efficiency, and product quality.
